arguments.body: Hi Luca, your yearly gas safety check is due before 16 October, and we haven't heard back from our earlier emails and text. We've booked HeatRight Ltd to visit 19 Victoria Park Road on Tuesday 13 October, between 10am and 1pm. This is your written notice of that visit. If the time doesn't suit, just reply with another time before 16 October and we'll rearrange; we won't enter without your agreement. The engineer will give a copy of the record, and you'll get a copy within 28 days of the check. Booking before expiry keeps the annual renewal date. We'll also write by letter and text. Thank you.
